widgets_values: 开=自动按源视频长度；关=按开始/结束秒数取片段。示例2→12秒输出240帧/10秒。单段最多345帧/14.375秒，尚未接入自动长视频分段。结束必须大于开始；超过源片末尾以剩余帧为准。画面比例自动跟随输入，MP只控制像素预算；宽高四舍五入到32倍数会有微小比例误差。

nodes.title: Viggle 官方噪声顺序

widgets_values:
subject_definitions:
<Video 1> is the source video to edit. Its main foreground performer is the replacement target.
<Picture 1> defines the appearance of <Subject 1>, the replacement character: preserve the exact face or head, body design, outfit, materials and colours visible in this reference.

summary:
[video editing + character replacement] The target video is an edited version of <Video 1>. Replace its main foreground performer with <Subject 1> from <Picture 1> throughout the complete output. Preserve the source actions, timing, camera movement, scene and interactions.

retention_analysis:
<Video 1> (source video editing): partially_preserved - preserve the shot structure, camera, scene, lighting, action timing, props and background people; change only the main foreground performer's appearance.
<Picture 1>: reference - the replacement character's exact appearance.
<Subject 1>: fully_preserved - maintain the same identity and outfit throughout, including wide shots, turns, occlusions and fast movement.
Source audio: fully_copy - keep the original soundtrack and its synchronisation.

detailed_description:
Follow the source video events in their original order and at their original speed. In every frame in which the target performer is visible, show the same replacement character with the source pose, motion and physical interactions. Reconstruct temporarily occluded body parts consistently as they become visible. Match the replacement to the source perspective, illumination, shadows, depth of field and motion blur. Keep unrelated people and objects unchanged. Maintain complete replacement through the final frame. Do not introduce new actions, camera moves, cuts or costume changes.

overall_soundscape:
Copy the source soundtrack without adding new dialogue or sound effects. If the source is silent, keep it silent.

non_diegetic_music:
Copy only music already present in the source. Otherwise N/A.
